# Google Ads Monitor API

> Monitor competitor Google Ads via Google Ads Transparency Center on Apify.
> Extracts ad copy via color-segmented OCR, firstShown launch dates, and active countries.

## Capabilities

- Tracks search ads (TEXT), display banners (IMAGE), and YouTube ads (VIDEO)
- Anchor on immutable firstShown timestamp to isolate genuinely new ads
- Color-segmented OCR v2 reads headlines and descriptions from archived PNGs
- Pay-per-event: $0.01 per competitor check + $0.0012 per ad ($0.70 to $1.20 per 1k)

## Endpoints

- Synchronous Actor run: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/sumitr_mardy~google-ads-monitor/run-sync-get-dataset-items`
- Actor Store: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/google-ads-monitor
- Pricing: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/google-ads-monitor/pricing
- Repository: https://github.com/sumitrmardy/google-ads-monitor-api

## Output Schema Summary

- `target` (string): Input domain or advertiser ID
- `targetType` (string): `domain` | `advertiser`
- `format` (string): `TEXT` | `IMAGE` | `VIDEO` | `UNKNOWN`
- `advertiserName` (string): Verified advertiser name
- `creativeId` (string): Stable creative ID (starts with CR)
- `firstShown` (string): ISO 8601 initial run date
- `lastShown` (string): ISO 8601 most recent run date
- `headline` (string): OCR-extracted or structured headline
- `description` (string): OCR-extracted or structured body copy
- `adUrl` (string): Link to ad on Google Ads Transparency Center
